speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I need to assess this newborn presenting with respiratory distress. Can you tell me the gestational age at birth and the mode of delivery, as well as the Apgar scores?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the prematurity and maternal history, I suspect Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn or Respiratory Distress Syndrome. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Findings: Ground-glass appearance, air bronchograms, suggesting Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)

speaker: Doctor
text: The chest X-ray findings of ground-glass appearance and air bronchograms are classic for Respiratory Distress Syndrome, especially in a premature infant. DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome
